question:
In this question, two statements are given followed by two conclusions. Choose the conclusion(s) which best fit(s) logically.

**Statements:**

1) All shawls are carpets.

2) No carpet is cloth.

**Conclusions:**

I. No cloth is carpet.

II. No shawl is cloth.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusion I and II follow
